orbital.birth: emit.ts76-82,116 and sampleCurve.ts71-117: one particle chance serves all channels and all birth values. Rates = authored per-axis rate*(2*chance-1). Values are radians/sec; correlated axes, no independent XYZ draws. Shape random calls use separate RNG draws.
orbital.spawn: emit.ts85-99: P_birth = O_birth + F_birth*(shapeOffset + EmitterPosition + translationOverride). Shape turn rotates birthVelocity then F_birth rotates it; orbital rates stored without these transforms.
orbital.integrated: integrate.ts488-495: position increment=velocityAfterFields*dt + bindWeight*originMoved + emitterSpaceShift; travel=increment/dt (or0). Birth orbital velocity is absent from this integration.
orbital.draw: particleRead.ts170-184,288-299: R=Ry(orbitalY*age)*Rx(orbitalX*age)*Rz(orbitalZ*age); drawn=O_current+R*(P_integrated-O_current)+worldAcceleration(emitterPhase)*age01*currentLifetime^2. Euler conversion to degrees is only standingInto interface. Allzero rates skip orbit.
orbital.pivotOrder: Orbit is around current draw-frame origin, after spawn+integrated motion+bind changes and before unturned worldAcceleration translation. Does not mutate pool.position or pool.travel. Changing current origin changes orbit pivot.
orbital.basis: Quads.tsx236-238 left-composes R over particleBasisInto; Meshes.tsx167-170 premultiplies equivalent mirrored orbital rotation. particleRead.ts225-254 direction basis uses unrotated pool.travel before caller composition; stretch264-278 raw speed.
orbital.billboard: shaders/quad.ts122-151: nondirected billboard uses roll, ignores own/orbital basis; directed billboard uses camera-projected orbited basisY, normalized or fallback[0,1], ignores roll. Both actual R noise/orbit emitters author isDirectionOriented1.
orbital.accelerationCaveat: Executable primary code only adds worldAcceleration displacement in drawnPlaceInto; comments154-163 claim world velocity addition but raw travel/basis code does not implement it. Existing local Zenith travel addition acceleration*life is an explicit divergence from executable65a7 code.

cylinder.sample: spawnShape.ts85-91: x=(volume?uniform[-1,1]:1)*radius; y=uniform[0,1)*height; z=0; then Ry(uniform[0,2pi)). Spin matrix also rotates birthVelocity in emit.ts95-99.
cylinder.distribution: Bokeh has height0, signed uniform radial distance with uniform angle: disk in local XZ, center-biased per-unit-area density. Do not substitute sqrt(U) radius uniform-area disk. RNG for height still consumed at height0.
cylinder.boundary: Only flag bit0 decoded; other bits are ignored by external reader. No native sampler/PRNG parity proven.

linger.settle: integrate.ts200-209 increments emitter age by dt then settles before integration/births. settle314-340: if stopped, finished iff age>stopWait; else only type2 and age>own emitter lifetime. First finished step sets finishedAt and lingerFrom=now for each resident particle.
linger.rewrite: Type0 L=min(oldL,lingerSeconds), an absolute lifetime cap; type1/type2 L=now-birthTime+lingerSeconds so deadline now+lingerSeconds. Type1 does not settle just on emitter lifetime. Existing dead particles do not resurrect. Integration retirement at age>=L follows settlement; zero linger retires same step.
